tools.name: start_intake
tools.description: Open a new benefits-screening intake. Returns the first `state` (pass it to every later call), the ten programmes, every question the engine can use (ids, options, amount units), and the first step.

tools.name: record_facts
tools.description: Record what the person said as typed facts (any questions, asked or volunteered; a fact for an answered question replaces it). Returns how each fact was read and the next step. Returns the new `state`; use it from now on. With an empty facts list it only returns the next step.

tools.name: get_assessment
tools.description: The current assessment: every programme's probability, tier and yearly value range, the facts recorded so far, and the expected cost of mistakes. A screening estimate, not an eligibility decision.
